title: Add first-party production analytics telemetry
description: Add pseudonymous first-party production-only analytics using a long-lived visitor cookie, session wall-clock duration, object detail clicks, Google Maps outbound clicks, backend /objects call metadata, optional rounded map location context, bot marking, structured Cloud Logging output, and a small analytics query doc. Verify through CI, deploy staging/prod, and confirm production logs are queryable in GCP.
close_reason: Production analytics deployed and verified in Cloud Logging

title: Night Mode: Light Hunters
description: Filter for objects with aviation lighting (using the existing LT field). Show a map of all the blinking red lights in the sky at night. People LOVE those mysterious blinking lights. Now they can finally know what they are.

title: The Tall Shit Index (Density Heatmap)
description: A density heatmap showing where tall shit concentrates. Discover that random Kansas counties have more tall shit per square mile than Manhattan. Regional rivalries. 'Texas has 63,344 obstacles and your state doesn't even have 2,000.'

title: Tall Shit Road Trip Planner
description: Give it a start and end point and it generates a road trip route that hits the most impressive tall shit along the way. Optimize for tallest, most varied types, or 'hidden gems' (tall stuff far from cities). Export to Google Maps.

title: Height Comparison Mode
description: Tap any object and see it visually compared to things people understand. 'This tower is 1.4 Statues of Liberty tall' or 'This is 0.6 Eiffel Towers.' A little side-by-side illustration. Silly but instantly shareable.

title: Tall Shit Photographer (Crowdsourced Photos)
description: Let users upload photos of the objects. Crowdsourced gallery. The FAA gives you coordinates and heights but no pictures — give these things faces. Photo of the day. Best shot wins... nothing, just glory.

title: AR Mode
description: Point your phone camera at the skyline and overlay labels on the tall shit around you in real time. 'That tower you've been wondering about? It's 1,247 ft AGL, FAA OAS #12345.' Uses device compass + GPS + existing object data. The feature that makes someone pull out their phone at a party to show people.

title: Tallest Shit Near Me Push Alerts
description: Opt-in notifications when you're near something exceptionally tall. Driving through Kansas? 'Hey, there's a 2,000 ft TV tower 3 miles off the highway.' Road trip mode that plots a route hitting the tallest things along the way.

title: What Can You See From Here? (Viewshed)
description: Line-of-sight visualization. Pick any tall object and render a viewshed — what's visible from the top? Use USGS elevation data to draw the visible area on the map. Bonus: show which OTHER tall shit you can see from any given tall shit. A network graph of tall things looking at each other.

title: Tall Shit Leaderboard
description: Gamify the app with check-ins and leaderboards. Users check in when they visit a tall thing. Track how many you've been to, how tall your total collection is. 'You've visited 847 feet of tall shit.' Badges for milestones: 'Tower Hound' (10 towers), 'Mile High Club' (5,280 cumulative feet), 'State Collector' (visited tall shit in 10+ states). Global and per-state leaderboards.
